Are you handy and detail-oriented? Start your career as an Assembly Operator at a technical production company in Oud-Beijerland and earn up to €3,223 per month (based on 40 hours). Enjoy great benefits and the chance for a permanent contract. Excited? 
Dit ga je doen 
As an Assembly Operator, you are responsible for assembling and putting together parts for high-quality automotive products. You'll mainly work day shifts (07:45 to 16:30), but you need to be flexible and willing to work in 2 or 3 shifts when required. You will be part of a team on various production lines, where the working language can be Dutch or English depending on the line. Your tasks include assembly work, operating machines, performing quality checks, and following technical instructions. You ensure each product meets strict quality standards and work with attention to detail. 
Ready to get started as an Assembly Operator? Apply today! If you have questions or want more information, just reach out to Jorim. We're happy to help you move forward!

Associate Scientist USP/DSP Eurofins Leiden, Netherlands Job Description 
As an Associate Scientist you are involved in both upstream (USP) and downstream (DSP) studies to support the development and optimization of bioprocesses to produce therapeutic proteins and other biologics. You are responsible for performing practical laboratory work and you are expected to contribute to data processing and reporting. You will act as a practical lead in the lab for studies and, together with the project team, help complete studies within agreed timelines. You are also involved in improvements within the department, and expected to volunteer ideas and follow-up these ideas. In summary, you will be: - Performing and supporting USP and/or DSP experiments, including cell culture, fermentation, protein purification, and filtration techniques; - Interpreting experimental data in the lab, and escalating any issues in a timely manner; - Contributing to documentation and reporting of studies; - Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams within the department; - Contributing to process development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement projects; - Maintaining laboratory equipment and complying with safety and quality standards. Qualifications - Master's degree or a BSc with 3 years of experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field; - Practical experience with USP (e.g., cell culture, bioreactors) and/or DSP (e.g., ÄKTA, UFDF); - Familiarity with GMP or GLP environments; - You are proactive, accurate, and solution oriented; - You have strong communication skills; - You can work under time pressure and manage your work independently; - Good command of the English language, both spoken and written. Dutch language skills are a plus.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and want to help build trucks? You can start even without any previous experience!

As truck body builder, you will work in the bodywork department, helping to build brand-new trucks from start to finish. You may also carry out repairs for existing customers. In many cases, you and your team will have built the entire vehicle yourselves. Working from technical drawings, you will build complete trucks together with your colleagues. Seeing the reaction of a customer when they collect their finished truck is extremely rewarding! 
You are focussed on details and strive for precision and perfection. Together, you aim to deliver every truck to the highest possible standard. 
Don't worry if you don't have any experience yet. If you are motivated to learn and enjoy contributing to a beautiful finished product, we encourage you to apply immediately!

 - An environment where you are allowed to make mistakes because that's how you learn - Friendly colleagues who are happy to teach you the trade - Plenty of opportunities to work independently - A long-term job with excellent career opportunities 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - You speak Dutch and/or English - You are willing to attend training courses and develop your skills - You are practical and enjoy working with your hands - You have an interest in technology and technical work

You will work in a close-knit team of skilled professionals. The company offers you the opportunity to further develop your skills within the truck bodywork and vehicle construction industry. 
They work for a wide range of clients, including companies in the food industry, construction, flower and horticulture sector, transport industry, and private customers.
